overview: A premium direct mail campaign command console that wraps the Lob API to let business owners design, target, and launch physical mail campaigns at scale.
features: 5-product catalog with layout selection (postcards, letters, self-mailers, snap packs, booklets)
Dual-path audience targeting: interactive geo map with radius/ZIP filtering + CSV upload with Lob address verification
Simplified design canvas with background image upload, draggable text blocks, and QR code overlay
Safe Zone, Cut Line, and Bleed Line boundary overlays on canvas
Admin control panel with masked API key management for Stripe, Lob, and Resend
Campaign history portal with live Lob webhook tracking (Created → Delivered)
Per-campaign CSV export with verified addresses and tracking IDs
